text:
customer-app-team: Hey team — hitting an odd streaming issue from our mobile app. First chunk arrives ~200ms, then nothing for ~8s, then the rest of the response arrives all at once. Repro id: req_01G4Y8ZQH. Using Redwood chat streaming (SSE) via our proxy (nginx), iOS URLSession.

maria: Thanks — can you paste the original request id and a minimal curl that reproduces? Also which SDK / SDK version?

customer-app-team: Request id above. Minimal curl we used (token redacted):

```bash
curl -N -X POST "https://api.redwood.run/v1/chat/stream" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \
  -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-chat-1","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"stream test\\n"}],"temperature":0.2}'
```

We also tested with our proxy folded in: client -> nginx (with proxy_buffering on) -> internal -> redwood. On the device we see the socket open and one small event then silence.

eng-oncall: Got it. Two quick hypotheses: 1) proxy/nginx buffering (proxy_buffering, proxy_max_temp_file_size), 2) client-side buffering in URLSession or iOS TCP Nagle (small chunks coalesced). Can you grab: the nginx config (proxy_buffering, proxy_http_version, chunked_transfer_encoding), a tcpdump of the session (first 30s), and the raw SSE stream from curl with --no-buffer / -N?

support-bot: Suggested quick checks added to ticket #2356.

alex: Also try `stdbuf -o0` or `--no-buffer` on Linux to disable stdio buffering. For iOS, a useful repro is to test with plain `curl -N` from a desktop (bypassing the app + proxy). If desktop shows smooth streaming while app doesn't, likely client/proxy. If both show stutter, likely upstream.

customer-app-team: Did a direct curl from my Mac (no proxy) — streaming looked fine. From our staging behind nginx it stutters. Nginx snippets below:

```nginx
proxy_http_version 1.1;
proxy_set_header Connection "";
proxy_buffering on; # staging default
proxy_buffers 8 16k;
proxy_busy_buffers_size 32k;
```

maria: That config is suspicious. Can you toggle `proxy_buffering off;` and `chunked_transfer_encoding on;` and retest? Also collect an nginx access log line for the request (include upstream_time and request length) and paste the exact response headers from the upstream (redwood) — we need to confirm Transfer-Encoding and Content-Type.

customer-app-team: Will toggle and retest. Before I do, what debug bundle should I upload? You asked for tcpdump — anything else?

eng-oncall: Please include: 1) nginx config file, 2) nginx error + access logs around request (include timestamps), 3) tcpdump (pcap) of the flow, 4) curl raw capture (`curl -svN ... > sse.raw`), 5) HAR from staging proxy if possible, 6) the SDK log from the mobile app (URLSession trace) with timing for bytesReceived. Zip and upload to the support portal and post the upload id here. If upload contains PII, mark it private.

customer-app-team: Uploaded bundle id: debug-uploads/2321-sse-stutter.zip. Contains nginx.conf, access.log, error.log, pcap, sse.raw, urlsession.log.

maria: Thanks — quick scan: upstream (redwood) is sending frequent small chunks with `Transfer-Encoding: chunked` and `Content-Type: text/event-stream`. Your nginx had `proxy_buffering on`, so it likely buffered until a threshold. That explains first chunk then delay. Can you confirm after switching `proxy_buffering off` whether the issue goes away? If it does, we can close as config issue and add recommended nginx snippet.

customer-app-team: Switched to `proxy_buffering off` and retested — streaming is smooth now. Confirmed on device too. Huge thanks.

alex: Great. For future reference, recommended nginx snippet: `proxy_http_version 1.1; proxy_set_header Connection ""; proxy_buffering off; chunked_transfer_encoding on; proxy_buffers 4 16k;` Also note keepalive and tcp_nodelay settings on the device side.

maria: Marking as resolved (root cause: nginx proxy_buffering). Adding KB note and will follow up to update docs on common proxy configs for SSE/websocket streaming. :white_check_mark:

customer-app-team: Awesome — appreciate the fast help :rocket:
